$comment: Single source of truth for the Mars Life Line art style. Read by the game (src/style/tokens.ts) and by scripts/kiln-style-sync.mjs, which writes the Kiln project design profile. Edit here, then follow docs/style/STYLE_GUIDE.md section 10.

space-deep.use: Opaque navy visors, windshields and darkest recesses; not the daytime sky

shadow-plum.use: Muted plum shadow faces, shaded terrain and ambient tone

regolith-mid.use: Iron-oxide red Martian soil and terracotta rock midtones

regolith-light.use: Pale ochre/terracotta sunlit rock tops and ground highlights

structure-white.use: Warm ivory structure panels, suits and vehicle bodies

structure-gray.use: Slate-grey frames, wrap-around ribs, chassis and doors

trim-dark.use: Tyres, recesses, panel gaps, dark mechanical parts

accent-orange.use: Warm accent paint stripes and warm emissive lights

accent-cyan.use: Cool emissive indicator lights and beacons

accent-blue.use: Cool emissive screens and signal lights

glass-tint.use: Light warm transparent glass for domes and windows

ice-pale.use: Water ice, ice apron and ice crates (material V-05)

matte-environment.description: Terrain, rocks, craters, mountains. Fully matte, no reflections.

smooth-structure.description: Buildings, modules, vehicles, suits, crates. Clean satin finish, never mirror-like.

accent-paint.description: Non-glowing orange colour blocking: side panels, crate faces, dome base band, suit pads, wheel hubs.

emissive-warm.description: Door frames, window strips, headlights. Selected surfaces only.

emissive-cool.description: Beacons, indicators, screens. Smaller and rarer than warm lights.

glass.description: Greenhouse domes, module windows. Light tint, soft highlight, see-through.

visor.description: Helmet visors and vehicle windshields. Opaque near-black, glossy, shows a soft highlight.

solar-cell.description: Solar panel cell faces. Deep blue, semi-gloss, framed by structure-white grid bars.

geometry.units: metres; +Y up; assets rest on Y=0; Kiln forward is +X

sky-top.use: Dusty rose upper sky; backdrop only

sky-horizon.use: Pale peach horizon and atmospheric haze; backdrop only
